name: Sugiura Mahiro
source: The protagonist's cousin. She is good at all kinds of housework, especially cooking. She is selfish and self-centered. She is true to her own feelings and ideas. She has a sharp tongue. She hangs out at the protagonist's house when he starts living alone, and acts like she owns the place.
translation: The protagonist's cousin. She is good at all kinds of housework, especially cooking. She is selfish and self-centered. She is true to her own feelings and ideas. She has a sharp tongue.
